Access · Auth
Login
Split-screen login: Cécile brand identity on the left, form on the right. Two distinct access paths — nutritionist and patient — from the same entry point.
Tap to expand
Differentiated access
The nutritionist accesses as clinic administrator. The patient enters via a private link sent by their doctor.
Visual identity
Warm earth palette, italic serif typography — designed to convey trust in a clinical context.
No doctor search
Not a marketplace. The patient-nutritionist relationship exists before the system.
Nutritionist panel · Admin
Patient directory
The nutritionist's main view. All active patients with their goal, progress percentage, estimated days to target and next appointment. Filterable by status: active, high priority or paused.
Tap to expand
Progress at a glance
Each card shows the initial → target weight range with a progress bar and estimated days to reach it.
High priority flag
The nutritionist can flag patients requiring special attention before the next appointment.
Patient-limited plans
Subscription plans based on patient count — the nutritionist sees their usage and can upgrade from the same interface.
Nutritionist panel · Admin
Appointment calendar
Monthly clinic agenda. Selecting a day shows scheduled appointments with patient name, time, consultation type and direct access to their file. New appointments can be added from the same view.

Contextual daily view
Selecting a day expands that date's appointments without leaving the monthly view.
In-person or remote
Each appointment shows the consultation type. The patient's file is one click away.
Nutritionist panel · Admin
Settings & integrations
Clinic settings panel. Shows the active plan and usage. Available integrations — Google Calendar, WhatsApp Business and automatic reminders 24h before each appointment — are toggled on without any technical setup.
Tap to expand
Google Calendar
Automatic sync of clinic appointments with the nutritionist's personal calendar.
WhatsApp Business
Automatic appointment reminders sent to the patient via WhatsApp without manual intervention.
24h reminders
Internal alert to the nutritionist about the next day's appointments for prior preparation.
Patient portal
Patient dashboard
Welcome view of the private portal. The patient sees their current goal with a progress bar, estimated days to reach it and the weekly shopping list prescribed by their nutritionist. The system automatically generates available recipes from that list.
Tap to expand
Private portal
The patient accesses via a unique link sent by their nutritionist. No other patients' data visible.
Smart shopping list
The nutritionist loads the prescribed foods and the system generates possible recipes from those ingredients.
Progress visible
The patient sees in real time how much they've progressed and how many days are estimated to reach the goal.
Patient portal
Meal plan
The core of the portal. For each meal of the day the system generates three recipe options built from the patient's shopping list. Each option shows calories and a link to the full recipe. The patient chooses freely — variety prevents plan dropout.
Tap to expand
3 options per meal
Breakfast, mid-morning, lunch, snack and dinner — each with variants to avoid repetition.
AI-generated
Recipes assembled automatically from the nutritionist's prescribed foods. None use ingredients outside the list.
Calories per option
Each recipe shows its caloric value so the patient can choose based on their daily goals.
Patient portal
Recipe detail
Clicking "View recipe" opens the full detail: dish photo, calories, prep time, servings, nutritional categories, exact ingredient quantities and step-by-step instructions. All generated from the patient's available ingredients.
Tap to expand
Dish photo
A representative image so the patient knows what they're preparing before they start.
Step by step
Numbered instructions designed for people with no cooking experience.
Nutritional tags
Fruits, vegetables, proteins, healthy fats — categorized to guide the patient on each meal's balance.
Patient portal
Supplements & activity routine
The nutritionist loads supplementation and activity routines into the patient's file. These appear in the portal with dosage, frequency, timing and clinical notes. The routine details sets, reps and training days.
Tap to expand
Supplementation with context
Each supplement includes the professional's directive and clinical reason, not just the dosage.
Structured routine
Exercises with sets, reps, rest time and days of the week.
Everything in one place
Diet, supplementation and physical activity in one portal. No need to check multiple channels.
Patient portal
Comments
Asynchronous communication channel between the patient and their nutritionist inside the system. Neither party can delete the other's messages — everything is logged as clinical history. Replaces informal WhatsApp without losing the accessibility of chat.
Tap to expand
Permanent history
Messages cannot be deleted. They remain as a record of progress and clinical communication.
Context preserved
The nutritionist sees comments inside the patient's file, with all clinical context alongside.
Out of WhatsApp
Clinical information moves out of informal chat and is centralized in the system where it belongs.
Patient portal
Food library
Full recipe catalog with photos, calories and prep time. The patient can browse all available options, filter by meal time and add recipes directly to their plan. It's the patient's space for autonomy within the system.
Tap to expand
Filter by meal time
Breakfast, lunch, snack, dinner — the patient browses by category based on what they need.
Add to plan
Any recipe from the library can be added to the plan with the + button, without the nutritionist's involvement.
Visual first
Photo-based design so browsing recipes is an enjoyable experience, not a text list.
Patient portal
Progress
Progress chart over time with three selectable metrics: body weight, body fat and muscle mass. Data is logged at each appointment and visible to the patient as objective evidence of their progress.
Tap to expand
Three metrics
Weight, fat and muscle mass — the patient switches between them with one click.
Per appointment
Each point on the chart corresponds to a real measurement taken at an appointment.
Objective motivation
Seeing progress on a chart has more impact than hearing it in an appointment.
Patient portal
Nutritionist notes
Full history of clinical notes ordered by appointment date. The nutritionist logs observations, plan adjustments and study results. The patient can read all of them — transparency is part of Cécile's care model.
Tap to expand
Chronological history
All notes from the first appointment, ordered from most recent to oldest.
Read-only for the patient
The patient reads the notes but cannot modify them. They are the professional's official record.
Complete clinical context
Caloric adjustments, test results, routine changes — the entire decision history in one place.
Patient portal
Clinical documents
Patient file repository: blood tests, medical prescriptions, densitometry studies, payment receipts. The nutritionist uploads them from the backoffice and the patient accesses them from their portal at any time and from any device.
Tap to expand
Categorized by type
Tests, prescriptions, receipts — each document has a tag to identify it at a glance.
Always available
The patient accesses their clinical documents from any device without relying on physical folders or emails.
Uploaded by the professional
The nutritionist uploads files from the backoffice. The patient has view and download access only.
